name: qlrisk_price_mbs
title: Price a MBS
description:
Price one Mortgage-Backed Securities (qlrisk MBS).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, face_value=100, coupon_pct=5.5, wac_pct, base_cpr_pct=6, refi_multiplier=8, oas_bp=50, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, position.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "face_value": 100} gives NPV 101.27 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
